meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 把代码库梳理成按功能分组的流程图,找出各功能里重复的代码,提出一个统一架构方案,并生成每个系统可直接套用的 /make-plan 计划提示。它不写实现代码,只产出图表、重复报告和交接提示。
howto.when: 当你说「find the ideal path」、要求统一重复系统,或说要重构前先审计架构时触发。

say.text: 找出这个代码库里的重复逻辑,画成流程图。
say.note: 会启动架构梳理,生成报告和统一方案。

say.text: 重构前,先审计一下现有架构,给出统一方案。
say.note: 产生 /make-plan 提示供后续使用。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 分析项目,按功能分组出流程图。

howto.what_en: Maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, flags duplicated concerns, and proposes a unified architecture, plus handoff prompts for /make-plan. It doesn't write implementation code; it produces diagrams, a duplication report, and handoff prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'find the ideal path', unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Find duplicated logic in this codebase and draw flowcharts for it.
say_en.note: Kicks off analysis, producing reports and a unified proposal.

say_en.text: Before refactoring, audit the current architecture and give a unified plan.
Use pathfinder to analyze the project and group features into flowcharts.
say_en.note: Produces diagrams and a duplication report.
